title: Essential Simplices Dominate in Harmonic Representatives of One-Dimensional Persistent Classes
summary: Persistent homology summarizes the birth and death of topological features, but it does not by itself specify where a feature is located in the underlying complex. Harmonic persistent homology addresses this by assigning canonical harmonic cycle representatives to bars. In earlier work, Basu and Cox showed that harmonic representatives of simple bars maximize the total relative weight placed on essential simplices, the simplices that are forced to appear in representatives of the corresponding class. In this paper we prove that, for generic one-dimensional bars, this preference is stronger…
